name: cove-extension-builder
description: Autonomous agent and skill suite for creating, testing, packaging, and syncing Cove plugins, tools, native React 19 UI, personal dashboard widgets, feature guides, WebXR VR experiences, downloaders (IDownloaderProvider), and metadata scrapers (IScraperProvider / YAML scraper-packs) for Cove 1.8.0+.

Build a background job and automation plugin for Cove with entity lifecycle events and tracked scopes

Sync and verify Cove extension builder reference contracts with latest upstream Cove releases
